notes.text: The tree shows now: live, across every window, in any theme.
Live tree — shows new and removed elements in the tree without a refresh.
Hidden changes — flash the nearest visible line when the change is under a fold.
Pause — queues updates while you read, then applies them at once.
All windows, one DevTools — every window is a node of one tree; F12 works anywhere.
Its own theme — DevTools looks the same under Fluent, Simple, any theme or none.
Settings card — remaps the gestures and toggles stay-on-top, live tree and update checks.
Version on the toolbar — turns blue with an ↑ when a newer version is out.
